saints.name: St. Sharbel Makhlūf
saints.title: Priest and Hermit
saints.shortBlurb: A Lebanese Maronite monk who lived hidden as a hermit and became a wonder of grace…
biography: Born in 1828 in the mountain village of Bekaa Kafra in Lebanon, Youssef Makhlouf entered the Lebanese Maronite Order and took the name Sharbel after an early martyr. After years in the monastery of Annaya he withdrew, with permission, to a nearby hermitage, where for some twenty-three years he lived in silence, fasting, and constant prayer before the Blessed Sacrament.
He died on Christmas Eve of 1898, and reports of light around his tomb and of many cures drew crowds of pilgrims of every faith. He was canonized by Pope Paul VI in 1977.
saints.knownFor: His hidden hermit's life and the miracles reported at his tomb.
